name: gsd-phase-status
description: Colour-codes GSD phase folders in the VS Code Explorer from .planning/ROADMAP.md and STATE.md.

gsdPhaseStatus.planningDir.description: Workspace-relative path to the GSD planning directory.

gsdPhaseStatus.showStatusBar.description: Show an overall phase counter in the status bar.

gsdPhaseStatus.showTodoCounts.markdownDescription: Badge `.planning/todos/pending` and `.planning/todos/completed` with how many todos are in them, and add an open-todo count to the status bar.

gsdPhaseStatus.discussedMarkers.markdownDescription: Files whose presence in a phase folder marks it as **discussed** (orange). `*` means any file counts. Checked only after `#gsdPhaseStatus.plannedMarkers#` fails to match.

gsdPhaseStatus.plannedMarkers.markdownDescription: Files whose presence in a phase folder marks it as **planned** (blue), meaning it is ready to execute. Takes precedence over `#gsdPhaseStatus.discussedMarkers#`. Keep the leading `*`: a bare `PLAN.md` matches only a file named exactly that, so per-wave files like `24-10-PLAN.md` go unrecognised and an unexecuted plan silently disappears from its phase's rollup.

gsdPhaseStatus.startedMarkers.markdownDescription: Deprecated. Pre-0.3 name for `#gsdPhaseStatus.discussedMarkers#`; still honoured if set.
